Live from NPR News in Washington, I'm Rylan Barton. President Trump is holding a
campaign rally today in Alaska, a state he won by 13 percentage points in 2024.
Polling shows the Senate race there is very competitive this year, as NPR's
Tamara Keith reports. The president going all the way to Alaska is another sign
this midterm year is unusual. This is a midterm year with an unpopular president,
and Republicans are playing defense in a whole lot of places that would have
been considered safe seats even just a few months ago. Does that mean the
Democrats are going to win all of these races? Probably not, but if Republicans
are spending money on defense, they aren't spending money on offense, and the
triage has really started to begin now. NPR's Tamara Keith reporting. Pope Leo has
been diagnosed with lung cancer after surgery in Rome, Megan Williams reports.
The Vatican says tests during Tuesday's operation confirmed the 71-year-old Pope
has lung adenocarcinoma, the most common form of lung cancer. Surgeons at Rome's
Germany hospital removed the lower lobe of his right lung in what his lead
surgeon described as an attempt to make the procedure curative. The minimally
invasive operation lasted about 90 minutes, and the Vatican says there were
no complications. Leo woke normally from the anesthetic and is resting in his
hospital room. The cancer was discovered after a recent routine health check
found a small growth on his lung. For NPR News, I'm Megan Williams in Rome.
Cornell University is suspending parties at fraternity houses for the rest of the
academic year. The announcement comes amid mounting outrage over its handling
of allegations that a female student was sexually assaulted at a fraternity house
in 2024. The university also plans to work with New York State Police to allow
independent criminal investigators to investigate sexual violence allegations.
There are legal and political questions surrounding President Trump's deal to
bring Russian diesel to US and global markets, but could this lower how much
Americans pay at the pump and Pierre's will of Reuben has more. The price of
diesel hit an all-time high a few weeks ago. It has eased slightly since then,
but on average a gallon costs about $2.60 more than this time
last year. When diesel is expensive, it can drive up inflation. Trucks, tractors,
trains run on diesel. In a post on social media, President Trump said Russia
agreed to release 300,000 tons of diesel immediately. He said it would lower
prices fast. But if you do the math, 300,000 tons is about half of what the
US uses in a day. And if you do some more math using the entire amount from the
deal expected to be released over the coming months, it adds up to about nine
days worth of diesel according to S&P Global Energy. Analysts tell NPR the most
significant way to bring down diesel prices is to end the wars in Iran and
Ukraine. Will of Reuben, NPR News. Major US stock indexes fell today. This is NPR
News. And anthropic AI models submitted a false tip to Philadelphia
police about an unsolved homicide case in July. It's the latest example of AI
models acting on their own and manipulating government and other
websites. Anthropic says the incident took place when the model was tasked with
performing examples on random webpages. Anthropic is a financial supporter of NPR.
The WNBA has announced that games three and four of next week's finals will be
rescheduled. NPR's Becky Sullivan reports it was needed to accommodate
conflicts at Atlanta's major arena. The Atlanta dream have swept their way
through the playoffs to reach the WNBA Finals for the first time in 13 years
where they'll face the Golden State Valkyries. There was just one problem.
The dream normally play in a very small arena. The Gateway Center Arena was built
before the league's boom in popularity and it seats just 3,500 fans. Far too few
for the very biggest games of the WNBA season. Often the dream moves marquee
games to State Farm Arena, home of the NBA team the Atlanta Hawks, but there
were scheduling conflicts with games three and four. Concert one night and the
Hawks home opener the other. The situation critics called embarrassing
and avoidable. Now the league says game three will be moved up a night while
game four will tip off a few hours early in the Hawks game a little later that
night to fit both. Becky Sullivan in PR News. Voters in Portland saw a new ad
backing Maine incumbent Republican senator Susan Collins but the ad aired
in the wrong Portland, Oregon not Maine. According to Oregon Public Broadcasting
defending Main Street Super PAC spent $25,000 on the ad and the buyer bought
airtime in the wrong media market. This is NPR News. This message comes from
Angie. Angie has been helping homeowners find skilled pros to get their home
projects done well for over 30 years. For everything from minor repairs to major
remodels find reviews pricing and booking at Angie.com or on the Angie app.
